title: Parsley Health header with announcement bar
description: A sticky two-tier header: a mint announcement bar (a short note, a small forest pill and a close ×) over an 82px deep-sea nav with a text wordmark, five medium links, a bone pill and a 'Log in →' link. Phones get a menu icon, a monogram and an outlined pill; the menu opens a deep-sea panel. Links fade to mint over 150ms on hover.
notes: sticky at the top of its parent; the nav bar is a .dark scope (deep sea in both modes)
the close × and the phone menu are CSS only (a checkbox and a details element)
